description: Command R is Cohere's optimized model for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and conversational applications. It features a 128K context window, strong multilingual support (10+ languages), and is designed for enterprise search and generation tasks.

trainingData.description: Trained on diverse multilingual data. Optimized for RAG applications with grounding in retrieved documents.

trainingProcedure: Optimized for retrieval-augmented generation with citation and grounding capabilities.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Strong performance on RAG tasks with accurate citation and grounding. Optimized for enterprise search applications.

knownLimitations: RAG quality depends on retrieval quality
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Evaluated for bias with mitigation applied.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Safety tuning and content filtering applied.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Enterprise deployment options available for privacy-sensitive applications.
